map.客单（件单价/连带率） 使用指南: Average Order Value (unit price / attachment rate) User Guide
map.输入成交额、订单数与件数，计算客单价、件单价与连带率，用于评估电商平效与搭配销售: Enter transaction value, order count and item count to compute average order value, unit price and attachment rate, for assessing e-commerce space efficiency and attachment sales, guiding operations improvement.
map.本工具按销售额、订单数与件数计算客单价、件单价与连带率，辅助门店连带销售分析。: This tool computes average order value, unit price and attachment rate from sales, order count and item count, supporting store attachment-sales analysis.
map.客单分析：录入销售额与订单数，算客单价。: Average order value analysis: enter sales and order count to compute average order value.
map.连带分析：录入件数与订单数，算连带率(件/单)。: Attachment analysis: enter item count and order count to compute the attachment rate (items / order).
map.教学演示：演示客单价=件单价×连带率。: Teaching demo: show average order value = unit price × attachment rate.
: example: sales 10,000, orders 200, items 320 gives average order value 50, unit price 31.25 and attachment rate 1.6 items/order.
